subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Dicyanoaurate（[Au(CN)₂]⁻）？
A. Linear
B. Trigonal planar
C. Square pyramidal
D. Trigonal bipyramidal
explanation: Linear. Covalent count: Au (group 11) 11 e; 2 × CN (X) 2 e; the 1− charge adds 1 e: 14 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −2 in all and the complex has a 1− charge, so the metal is Au(I), d¹⁰; d¹⁰ + 4 e from the ligands = 14 e.
